ORGI Opens Offline Applications for 26 Deputation and Contract Posts in New Delhi

30 Oct 2026, 12:26 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: www.freejobalert.com

The Office of the Registrar General, India (ORGI), operating under the Ministry of Home Affairs in New Delhi, has released an official notification inviting applications to fill 26 vacant posts on a deputation or short-term contract basis. The recruitment drive covers multiple specialized positions, including roles in mapping, drawing, linguistics, and analysis.

Eligible serving officers from Central Governments, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, recognized universities, research institutions, public sector undertakings, and autonomous bodies can submit their applications through the proper channel. The initial tenure for these appointments is set for three years or until further orders, whichever comes first.

Available Vacancies and Pay Scale Structure

The 26 openings are distributed across five distinct designations, offering pay scales ranging from Level-8 to Level-12 of the pay matrix:

  • Assistant Registrar General (Map): 1 post (Level-12, Rs. 78,800 – Rs. 209,200)
  • Research Officer (Map): 12 posts (Level-10, Rs. 56,100 – Rs. 177,500)
  • Research Officer (Drawing): 3 posts (Level-10, Rs. 56,100 – Rs. 177,500)
  • Research Officer (Language)/Linguist: 1 post (Level-10, Rs. 56,100 – Rs. 177,500)
  • Map Analyst: 9 posts (Level-8, Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 151,100)

The regulation of pay for selected candidates will follow the Department of Personnel and Training's official guidelines outlined in O.M.No.16/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II).

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

Applicants must meet specific educational backgrounds, experience requirements, and service conditions corresponding to their target position. Essential requirements generally feature appropriate master's or bachelor's degrees alongside professional experience in Geographic Information System (GIS), remote sensing, geography, cartography, or linguistics.

  • Age Limit: Candidates must not exceed 56 years of age as of the closing date for receipt of applications.
  • Organization Types: Central and State government officers are eligible for deputation, while candidates from non-government organizations are restricted to short-term contracts. Semi-government organization officers may apply specifically for the Research Officer (Language)/Linguist position.
  • Exclusions: Departmental officers in feeder categories who fall in the direct line of promotion are ineligible for deputation or short-term contract appointments.

Application Procedure and Submission Details

Interested and eligible candidates must compile their application in duplicate using the Annexure-II proforma available via the official portal. Applications require proper certification and must be forwarded by the candidate's controlling officer, employer, or cadre-controlling authority.

The completed application package must include self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience proofs, a 10-year major/minor penalty statement, a vigilance clearance/integrity certificate, and attested photocopies of Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs) for the years 2020-21 through 2024-25.

Submissions must be mailed via proper channel to:

> The Under Secretary, Admin-III Section, > Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, > Ministry of Home Affairs, Janganana Bhawan, 3rd Floor, > 2-A Mansingh Road, New Delhi - 110011.

Practical Implications and Verification Guide

For applicants planning to apply, understanding the procedural constraints is vital:

  • Confirmed Details: The total vacancy count (26), maximum age ceiling (56 years), required documentation (APARs, vigilance clearance, Annexure-II), and the postal submission address are explicitly confirmed by the official circular signed by Under Secretary Sunil Kumar Mishra.
  • Unknowns & Omissions: The official notification does not disclose application fees or specific selection stages beyond document verification and committee assessment.
  • Important Caveats: Candidates cannot withdraw their candidature once submitted. Incomplete applications, late arrivals, or documents lacking proper forwarding authority signatures will face outright rejection.

Readers can verify complete details, download Annexure proformas, and read the original circular directly on the [Official Census India Website](https://www.censusindia.gov.in) or reference the announcement summary via [FreeJobAlert Source Article](https://www.freejobalert.com/articles/orgi-recruitment-2026-apply-offline-for-26-assistant-registrar-general-research-officer-and-more-posts-3074962).
